heading_path: Part 6—Amendment of application for registration of a trade mark and other documents
Division 1—Amendment of application for registration of trade mark and other documents
text: For the purposes of subsection 65A(3) of the Act, the request for the amendment must be published in a computer database maintained by the Trade Marks Office.
title: Publication of request for amendment
